ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a dominant low-intensity (black) pixel base (approx. 75-80%) and high-intensity (white) localized zones concentrated along the distal trailing edges and lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous zones are mapped to the distal one-third of both the left and right lobes, characterized by irregular, feathered margins. The central fluke area and proximal regions exhibit solid low-intensity black pixels with fine-grained white mottling throughout.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 85 degrees; depth extends significantly toward the peduncle junction before being obscured by surface water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire visible trailing edge. Distinct sharp peaks (spicules) are clustered at the distal extremities with an average peak-to-valley amplitude of 5-12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature (inward sweep) along the trailing edge, transitioning to a sharp upward taper at the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and diagonal high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) detected; most prominent on the mid-section of the right lobe, intersecting the dark pigment base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular scarring and pigment loss along the uppermost distal margins of both lobes, consistent with localized surface trauma or abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: Specular highlights from water droplets create localized high-intensity pixel noise across the central fluke surface, partially obscuring the texture of the median notch.
